descriptors.label: Public FQDN
descriptors.description: Fully qualified name NetBox is reached by; used for ALLOWED_HOSTS and the TLS certificate. Empty derives it from the guest hostname and the addresses held at first boot

descriptors.label: Time Zone
descriptors.description: IANA time zone for NetBox, for example Europe/Prague; empty means UTC

descriptors.label: Admin Username
descriptors.description: NetBox superuser created on first boot; empty means admin

descriptors.label: Admin Email
descriptors.description: Email address of the NetBox superuser; empty means admin@example.com

descriptors.label: Admin Password
descriptors.description: Password for the NetBox superuser. Leave empty (recommended) to generate one and read it from the VM console or /root/netbox-credentials.txt; values entered here are stored in the VM configuration in cleartext and are readable by any vCenter user with access to the VM

descriptors.label: Metrics Allowlist
descriptors.description: Space or comma separated addresses/CIDRs allowed to scrape /metrics and /node-metrics; empty leaves Prometheus metrics and node-exporter switched off

descriptors.label: TLS Certificate Chain (base64 PEM)
descriptors.description: Base64-encoded PEM certificate chain for nginx; empty generates a self-signed certificate. HSTS is only sent when a certificate is supplied here, because HSTS makes a self-signed warning impossible to click through

descriptors.label: TLS Private Key (base64 PEM)
descriptors.description: Base64-encoded PEM private key matching the certificate above; required only when a certificate is supplied

descriptors.label: External PostgreSQL Host
descriptors.description: Host or host:port of an external PostgreSQL 14+ server; empty uses the appliance's local PostgreSQL over a Unix socket with peer authentication (no password anywhere)

descriptors.label: External Database Name
descriptors.description: Database name on the external server; empty means netbox

descriptors.label: External Database User
descriptors.description: Login role on the external server; empty means netbox

descriptors.label: External Database Password
descriptors.description: Password for the external database role; stored in the VM configuration in cleartext, so prefer a dedicated least-privilege role

descriptors.label: External Redis Host
descriptors.description: Host or host:port of an external Redis 6+ server; databases 0 and 1 are used for tasks and caching. Empty uses the appliance's local Redis on loopback

descriptors.label: External Redis Password
descriptors.description: Password for the external Redis server; stored in the VM configuration in cleartext
